items.quote: Der Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Finanzamt Beispielhausen, Am Musterwall 7, 31134 Beispielhausen, schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen oder dort zur Niederschrift zu erklären.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 27.10.2025, sent by ordinary post. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter sent by simple post is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: 27.10.2025 + 4 days = Fri 31.10.2025. That day (Reformationstag) is a public holiday in Niedersachsen, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deemed-delivery day shifts to the next working day, Mon 03.11.2025. The one-month Einspruch period of § 355 Abs. 1 AO then runs from that day: under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO the day of delivery itself is not counted, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the period ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. Wed 03.12.2025. That day is a normal business day (no weekend/holiday shift needed), so the deadline is 03.12.2025.
